name: EXILED [ WIZARD! ]
desc:
In this game, you play as an exiled prisoner navigating abandoned lands filled with threats. Stay vigilant, gather treasures and items, and survive to reach a safe haven.

[✨] Please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates.

[🎧] Use headphones and max graphics for a better experience. 

[ ❗ ] Game contains light horror content. 

Inspired by PILGRIM and Lethal Company.
